LanguageData.AS_AssignCType: Assign cultivation type, this cannot be undone if they have finished foundation training. If toggled before foundation progress is maxed they wil automatically begin that cultivation type after foundation is maxed.
LanguageData.AS_EssenceCultivationDesc: Cultivate immortality using Qi, progression grants use of various Technique Arts that provide various combat and utility abilities that use Qi, and increases various qi related stat offsets.
LanguageData.AS_BodyCultivationDesc: Cultivate immortality using Exercise, progression grants increased bodily functions. (WIP, needs True Qi, Remoulding, Secret Bodies, etc.., will be added in Body Cultivation update.)
LanguageData.AS_NoneCultDesc: No cultivation type selected. A selection is required before progressing past foundation training.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationCauldronBaseQiDesc: The base amount of qi the cauldron has on its own.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationCauldronCurrentQiDesc: The total amount of qi on all the tiles the cauldron occupies, plus Base Qi. Determines the max quality of products produced from the cauldron.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationCauldronMaxQualityDesc: The maximum quality of products made in this cauldron. Scales with Current Qi.
LanguageData.AS_ShowQiToggleButton: Toggle the Qi display.\n\nDisplay the Qi of the world as would be present where the cursor is pointing.
LanguageData.AS_ShowElementToggleButton: Toggle the Element display.\n\nDisplay the Element of the world as would be present where the cursor is pointing.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationUniformCSDesc: The amount of offset to Cultivation Speed granted to its wearer.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationUniformQRSDesc: The amount of offset to Cultivation Speed granted to its wearer.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationUniformMQDesc: The amount of offset to Max Qi granted to its wearer.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationUniformFTDesc: The amount of offset to cultivation speed granted to its wearer if they are training thier foundation.
LanguageData.AS_LifePillLifespanAmountDesc: The amount of lifespan granted upon consumption.
LanguageData.AS_SpiritPillInspect: Qi Cost: {COST}\nMultiplier: {OFFSET}x Max Qi and Qi Recovery
LanguageData.AS_SpiritPillQiCostDesc: The amount of Qi required to survive consumption.
LanguageData.AS_SpiritPillMultiplierDesc: The multiplier for Max Qi and Qi Recovery given after consumption if survived.
LanguageData.AS_GoldenPillQiDesc: The amount of Qi given upon consumption.
LanguageData.AS_SpiritTreeConversionDesc: A sudden surge of Qi has converted a tree into a spirit tree.
LanguageData.AS_CommandCultivationSpotSetOwnerDesc: Assign this cultivation spot to be owned by a specific colonist.
LanguageData.AS_ChangePriorityDesc: Change the priority of the cultivation spot.
LanguageData.AS_ChangeRealmDesc: Change the target realm of the cultivation spot.
LanguageData.AS_ChangeElementDesc: Change the target element of the cultivation spot.
LanguageData.AS_ChangeJobDesc: Change the specific cultivation job of the cultivation spot.
LanguageData.AS_TogglePublicDesc: Toggle on/off public use. Ownership is ignored while public.
LanguageData.AS_HeavenlyTribulationStats:
Stats are determined when the tribulation is created based on the following factors: 
Base of {QIOFFSET} * Max Qi = Qi: {QI}, 
Base of {STRENGTHOFFSET} * 5% of Qi * (Qi Recovery Speed + 1 ) = Strength: {STRENGTH}, 
Base of {SPEEDOFFSET} * Cultivation Speed = Speed: 1 hour divided by {SPEED} = {TRANSLATEDSPEED}

{TRANSLATEDTIMELEFT} until Tribulation.
LanguageData.AS_ElementEmitRangeDesc: How far the object with Element Emit permeates its surroundings with its element.
LanguageData.AS_ElementEmitAmountDesc: The amount of the element emitted that the object with Element Emit grants to its surroundings, this is multiplied by stack count for the actual element amount.
LanguageData.AS_ElementEmitElementDesc: The element emitted with by the object.
LanguageData.AS_ElementEmitAmountTorchDesc: The amount of the element emitted that the object with Element Emit grants to its surroundings, this is always 0 if the torch is unlit.
LanguageData.AS_ConfirmDesc: Confirm the selected cultivation type, letting the cultivator begin this type of cultivation after they have finished thier foundation. Cannot confirm before choosing a cultivation type.
LanguageData.AS_TickRatesDesc: Settings for tick rates of various features. Lowering will reduce lag but increase the amount of time it takes for the feature to act properly.
LanguageData.AS_NotificationsDesc: Settings to disable or enable various notifications, letters, etc...
LanguageData.AS_MiscDesc: Miscellaneous settings that done fit anywhere in particular.
LanguageData.AS_LifespanAgeRatio: Lifespan Age Ratio: {SETTING}% of Remaining Life-Expectancy
LanguageData.AS_LifespanAgeRatioDesc: For determining the target biological age to de-age to when the lifespan is above life-expectency. The target age is the minimum adult age of the cultivator (13 years for most humanoids), plus a percentage of thier remaining life-expectancy (life-expectancy minus min adult age) determined by this setting. 15% by default.
LanguageData.AS_MaxRandLifespanDesc: Maximum random lifespan of random cultivators. Amount is the cultivators biological age minus thier life-expectancy is multiplied by realm tier (7x is max), and added after base lifespan generated from the cultivators race and current age.
LanguageData.AS_BaseCultivationSpeedDesc: Base cultivation speed, 1 by default. Keep in mind most cultivation is balanced around time spent, so anything above 1 can be really OP. Beware that the lightning strike speed of Heavenly Tribulations scale with cultivation speed of its victim upon creation.
LanguageData.AS_CultivatorChanceDesc: Determines the probability of a pawn being a cultivator with random realm progression when spawned.
LanguageData.AS_AbilityChanceDesc: Determines the probability of a cultivator gaining random scroll arts / abilities when spawned. Slightly below displayed percentage if no useable scrolls are found.
LanguageData.AS_PCChanceDesc: Determines the probability of a random cultivators realm progression being high end when spawned, while also increasing max Golden Core scores if the cultivator is a essence cultivator and Anima Conversion amounts generated by 2x.
LanguageData.AS_ERChanceDesc: Determines the probability of random cultivators being in a essence realm when spawned. Essence realms are after body realms.
LanguageData.AS_FoundationChanceDesc: Chance for a randomly generated cultivator to not have foundation training finished. This overrides powerful cultivators too, meaning that if this is too high you wont see many powerful cultivators regardless of the chance for them.
LanguageData.AS_DefaultEssenceTypeDesc: Default cultivation type of controllable cultivators is essence while enabled, body while disabled. Non-controllable cultivators type is determined by essence chance.
LanguageData.AS_DefaultConfirmDesc: All controllable cultivators will have thier cultivation type confirmed by default when enabled, the inverse is true if disabled. Disabled by default. Non-controllable cultivators are always confirmed.
LanguageData.AS_DisableHTLettersDesc: Disable Heavenly Tribulation letters incase you have too many cultivates and are getting spammed. False by default to prevent accidental tribulation deaths/injuries.
LanguageData.AS_DisablePLettersDesc: Disable progress letters such as breakthrough possible. True by default due to these letters being a remanent of before the mod had auto-cultivation.
LanguageData.AS_DisplayQiDesc: Display the gather qi values on the map/screen.
LanguageData.AS_DisplayElementDesc: Display the element values on the map/screen.
LanguageData.AS_LifespanTickRateDesc: The amount of ticks between each check for de-aging colonist with high lifespans. De-aging is not gradual so large tick rates are ideal for large colonies.
LanguageData.AS_SMTickRate: Soul Mend Tick Rate: Per {SETTING} Ticks
LanguageData.AS_SMTickRateDesc: The amount of ticks between each check if a pawn using soul mend is dead. Higher values means less lag with high amounts of soul menders but also a longer wait for resurrection.
LanguageData.AS_SMRandStacks: Max Random Soul Mend Stacks: {SETTING} Charges
LanguageData.AS_SSMRandStacksDesc: The max amount of soul mend stacks a random cultivator with the soul mend ability can generate with.
LanguageData.AS_GoldenCoreMaxDesc: The maximum Golden Core score generated for a random cultivator. This is not the maximum possible from a Golden Core breakthrough and only effects randomly generated cultivators. Random Immortal cultivators can have no less than between 1x - 4x this score (excluding the lucky psuedo-immortal Powerful Cultivators) and Powerful Cultivators can have up to 2x this score.
LanguageData.AS_AnimaCMaxDesc: The maximum Anima Conversion amount generated for a random cultivator. Inner Cauldron random generation is always 0-1200 and turns into Anima Conversion after achieving a Golden Core, removing its previously mentioned limit. Random Immortal cultivators can have no less than between 1x - 4x this amount (excluding the lucky psuedo-immortal Powerful Cultivators) and Powerful Cultivators can have up to 2x this amount.
LanguageData.AS_LogHealsDesc: Enable if you want to log heals from this mod in console. May flood the console if too many heals take place.
LanguageData.AS_PCMaxDesc: Maximum realm that a powerful random cultivator is spawned at.
LanguageData.AS_PCMinDesc: Minimum realm that a powerful random cultivator is spawned at.
LanguageData.AS_CultivationSpeedDesc: The speed at which cultivators do cultivation jobs like Exercise, Refine Qi, Gather Qi, Breakthroughs, etc.
LanguageData.AS_QiTileDesc: The amount of Qi in the cultivators current position. Increases gather qi yield by the same amount and increases cultivation speed by 1/100th the amount.
LanguageData.AS_GoldenCoreDesc: A golden core which grants the cultivator additional max qi equal to the score. Currently grants +{SCORE} Max Qi.
LanguageData.AS_QiRecoveryAmountFactorsDesc: The factors influencing qi recovery amount.
LanguageData.AS_QiRecoverySpeedFactorsDesc: The factors influencing qi recovery speed.
LanguageData.AS_InnerCDesc: The Inner Cauldron increases a cultivators max Qi by the amount of Qi refined into it.
LanguageData.AS_AnimaCDesc: Inner Cauldron converts into Anima Conversion once a Golden Core is cultivated. Anima Conversion also grants max qi but is uncapped and can be increased indefinitely by cultivating it for long enough.
LanguageData.AS_InnerCJobDesc: Meditate for 6 hours divided by cultivation speed to refine 2 + 2% max qi into the Inner Cauldron to grant more max qi equal to the amount refined if not at the limit.
LanguageData.AS_AnimaCJobDesc: Meditate for 6 hours divided by cultivation speed to convert 2 + 2% max qi into Anima to grant more max qi equal to the amount converted.
LanguageData.AS_RealmAutoDesc: Auto-cultivate Current Realm. (This includes gathering qi if they are in a essence realm)
LanguageData.AS_RealmOnlyAutoDesc: Auto-cultivate Current Realm only. (This excludes gathering qi if they are in a essence realm)
LanguageData.AS_InnerCAutoDesc: Automatically refine qi into {IC} only. Includes qi gathering.
LanguageData.AS_FoundationTrainingDesc: Train for 1 hour to progress in your foundation by 10.
LanguageData.AS_FoundationDesc: A foundation must be established by a mortal before they can truly begin cultivation. The type of cultivation can be chosen and changed before the foundation is built but afterwards when they begin cultivating that type the choice is permanent (excluding rebirth pills).
LanguageData.AS_NoCultChosenError: You must choose a cultivation type to progress further.
LanguageData.AS_TConversionsLeft: Qi to essence realm progress conversions left.
LanguageData.AS_RefineQiDesc: Meditate for 2 hours divided by cultivation speed to Refine Qi into progress on essence realms. 10% max qi plus 2 qi is used in each refinement, progressing by the same amount of qi used.
LanguageData.AS_ExerciseDesc: Exercise for 4 hours divided by cultivation speed to progress 1 + (10% {ELEMENT}: {ELEMENTAMOUNT}) + (1% max progress) in the current body realm.
LanguageData.AS_QiGatheringDesc: Meditate for 3 hours divided by cultivation speed to gather natural qi from your surroundings. Generates 1 qi plus the amount of Gather Qi in the cultivators position.
LanguageData.AS_GoldenCoreBreakthroughDesc: Try to get as much Qi as possible before attempting. Meditate for 1 hour divided by cultivation speed for each Qi conversion of 100 qi during a Golden Core Breakthrough until less than 100 qi remains. The resulting golden core score is equal to the amount of qi converted. This breakthrough cannot fail, but golden core scores are permanent.
LanguageData.AS_BreakthroughEssenceDesc: Meditate for 7 hours divided by cultivation speed to breakthrough to the next essence realm. Breakthrough Chance: {CHANCE}%
LanguageData.AS_BreakthroughBodyDesc: Exercise for 7 hours divided by cultivation speed to breakthrough to the next realm. Breakthrough Chance: {CHANCE}%
LanguageData.AS_GatherQiRangeDesc: How far the object with Gather Qi permeates its surroundings.
LanguageData.AS_GatherQiAmountDesc: The amount of Qi that the object with Gather Qi grants to its surroundings. This is multiplied by stack count for the actual qi amount.
LanguageData.AS_HTLetterDesc: {PAWN} will undergo Heavenly Tribulation in 3 days.
LanguageData.AS_BodyRealmDec: The current body realm of the cultivator. Body realm cultivation provides enchanced bodily functions, and is needed to surpass the bodies limits of qi storage to progress to the essence realms.(Essence realms start after breakthrough of the last body realm 'Flesh Molding')
LanguageData.AS_EssenceRealmDec: The current essence realm of the cultivator. Essence realm cultivation provides passive qi generation.
LanguageData.AS_CBreakthroughDesc: Meditate for hours to breakthrough to the next tier of Ascendant Foundation or Pseudo-Immortalality.
LanguageData.AbilityDisabledNoAFOrPI: Ability disabled, no Ascendant Foundation or Pseudo-Immortality found.
LanguageData.AbilityDisabledERProgLow: Ability disabled, Essence Realm not high enough.
LanguageData.AbilityDisabledBRProgLow: Ability disabled, Body Realm not high enough.
LanguageData.AbilityDisabledPIProgLow: Ability disabled, Pseudo-Immortality tier too low.
LanguageData.AbilityDisabledNoQiPool: Ability disabled, no qi pool found.
LanguageData.AbilityDisabledNoQi: Ability disabled, not enough qi in pool.
LanguageData.AS_HumanoidCultivatorDesc: Enable if you want the spawn chance to only affect humanoid pawns.
LanguageData.AS_MachineCultivatorDesc: Enable if you want the spawn chance to affect mechanical pawns. Enabling is not recommended for Biotech users unless you want to randomly gestate pseudo-immortal mechs.
LanguageData.AS_OPGoldenPills: Same Ascendant Foundation Tier As Golden Pill Tier
LanguageData.AS_OPGoldenPillsDesc: DO NOT ENABLE ON "SERIOUS" PLAYTHROUGHS. Enable if you want Golden Pills to give the same tier of Ascendant Foundation as the tier of the Golden Pill. This makes foundation building extremley easy using high tier pills especially since it BYPASSES BREAKTHROUGHS, so it is not recommended for any serious playthough.
LanguageData.AS_LifespanDesc: The cultivators Lifespan. De-ages them to thier races minimum adult age when above thier life-expectancy. Efficiency divides the cost of the de-ageing. Current life-expectancy is {LEYEARS} years.
